meta.author:
約書亞樂團
詞、曲 Brian Johnson, Jeremy Riddle

lines.a: 我站在山頂上  大聲呼喊宣告
lines.b: I want to scream it out, from every mountain top

lines.a: 祢良善無止盡  永遠不會停息
lines.b: Your goodness knows no bounds, Your goodness never stops

lines.a: 祢慈愛隨著我  充滿我的生命
lines.b: Your mercy follows me, Your kindness fills my life

lines.a: 祢愛讓我驚奇
lines.b: Your love amazes me

lines.a: And I Sing 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I sing because You are good

lines.a: And I Dance 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I dance because You are good

lines.a: And I Shout 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I shout because You are good

lines.a: 祢真好 祢真好
lines.b: You are good, good to me

lines.a: And I Sing 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I sing because You are good

lines.a: And I Dance 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I dance because You are good

lines.a: And I Shout 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I shout because You are good

lines.a: 祢對我真好
lines.b: You are good to me

lines.a: And I Sing 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I sing because You are good

lines.a: And I Dance 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I dance because You are good

lines.a: And I Shout 因爲祢真好
lines.b: And I shout because You are good

lines.a: 再沒有任何人 能夠與祢相比
lines.b: Nothing and no one comes, anywhere close to You

lines.a: 天地和深海洋 都顯明這真理
lines.b: The earth and oceans deep, only reflect this truth

lines.a: 在黑暗的時刻 祢如明亮晨星
lines.b: And in my darkest night, You shine as bright as day

lines.a: 祢愛讓我驚奇
lines.b: Your love amazes me

lines.a: 我全心宣告 讓世界知道
lines.b: With a cry of praise my heart will proclaim

lines.a: 祢真好 祢真好
lines.b: You are good You are good

lines.a: 晴天或雨天 我都要讚美
lines.b: In the Sun or rain my life celebrates

lines.a: 祢真好 祢真好
lines.b: You are good You are good
